description: Clawix host and UI vocabulary extensions for the shared ClawJS naming standard.

conceptualGuard.description: Clawix host/UI extension of the shared conceptual vocabulary guard. Existing ambiguous debt is frozen in docs/conceptual-vocabulary-baseline.json.

terms.canonicalMeaning: Domain-specific lifecycle or legal relationship only; framework authority uses principals, stewards, grants, scopes, authority edges, and restrictions.
terms.replacementGuidance: Use steward, principal, grant, scope, authorityEdge, restriction, or a domain-specific owner phrase.

blockedPatterns.suggestion: Do not use generic owner vocabulary for authority. Use steward/principal/grant/scope or a documented domain owner field.
Spell out the explicit grant, steward, principal, entity, and scope relationship.

terms.canonicalMeaning: Explicit grant/restriction graph semantics, not implied by ownership, sync, workspace membership, or hierarchy.
terms.replacementGuidance: Use authorityEdge, grant, restriction, effective authority, or control capability with scope.

blockedPatterns.suggestion: Do not imply authority from grouping. Use explicit grants, restrictions, and authority edges.

terms.canonicalMeaning: Technical isolation in provider, hosting, relay, gateway, or compatibility code only.
terms.replacementGuidance: Use workspace, project, entity, scope, or provider tenant when the remote service really uses tenant semantics.

blockedPatterns.suggestion: Tenant is technical isolation only. Use workspace, project, entity, scope, principal, or provider tenant.

terms.canonicalMeaning: Isolated context for sessions, memory, resource bindings, and defaults; not an authority source by itself.
terms.replacementGuidance: Use workspace for isolation and scope; use grants/restrictions for authority and project for collaborable work scope.

blockedPatterns.suggestion: Workspace is an isolated context. Use explicit grants/restrictions for authority and stable IDs for identity.

terms.canonicalMeaning: Collaborable human work scope with stable identity and mutable folder locators.
terms.replacementGuidance: Use project for work scope; use folder/path only as locators and grants/restrictions for authority.

blockedPatterns.suggestion: Project membership or folder location must not imply authority. Use explicit grants and stable project IDs.

terms.canonicalMeaning: A principal or runtime actor that can act only within explicit effective authority.
terms.replacementGuidance: Use principal/grant/delegation wording for authority; use agent for the actor/runtime role.

blockedPatterns.suggestion: Agents do not imply authority. Model them as principals with explicit grants and delegation limits.

terms.canonicalMeaning: Registered human or programmatic interface with evidence and ownership.
terms.replacementGuidance: Register the surface or call it internal implementation detail.

blockedPatterns.suggestion: Stable capabilities need registered human/programmatic surface evidence.

terms.canonicalMeaning: Signed native owner of sensitive capabilities and host-specific operational state.
terms.replacementGuidance: Use signed host for native authority; do not move native authority to Node or Relay.

blockedPatterns.suggestion: Sensitive native authority belongs to the signed host.

terms.canonicalMeaning: Transport or brokering surface, not the authority owner for native permissions, secrets, or grants.
terms.replacementGuidance: Use relay for transport/brokering and signed host/framework governance for authority.

blockedPatterns.suggestion: Relay may broker routes, but authority must remain explicit in host/framework governance.

terms.canonicalMeaning: User-configured bridge to an external account or service; integration is the broader domain.
terms.replacementGuidance: Use connector account/setup for configured external credentials.

blockedPatterns.suggestion: Use connector account or connector credential for configured external accounts.

terms.canonicalMeaning: Replication or reconciliation behavior; sync/share never grants authority by itself.
terms.replacementGuidance: Use sync for replication and explicit grants/restrictions for access.

blockedPatterns.suggestion: Sync does not imply authority. Use explicit grants, restrictions, and share policy.

terms.definition: Framework/bridge conversation identity when Clawix talks to ClawJS or durable protocol surfaces.

contextOnlySynonyms.reason: Chat is current product UI vocabulary, but session is the stable framework/protocol word.

forbiddenSynonyms.reason: Use sessionId for framework/bridge conversation identity.
Use session/open-session language for stable bridge commands.

externalExceptions: UI-local Chat model during staged cleanup

correct: threadId beside sessionId for runtime reconciliation
incorrect: chatId as a new bridge protocol field

terms.definition: Stable Clawix host bridge service name.

forbiddenSynonyms.reason: The accepted service name is clawix-bridge.

terms.definition: Signed native owner of Clawix operational state and sensitive native capabilities.

forbiddenSynonyms.reason: Sensitive native authority belongs to the signed host, not Node.

terms.definition: Technical maintenance responsibility for Clawix governance registries and durable meta-code; it never grants authority by itself.

forbiddenSynonyms.reason: Use steward for technical responsibility and explicit grants/scopes for authority.

terms.definition: Technical responsibility for a registered Clawix surface node, edge, or route; it describes lifecycle maintenance, not authority.

forbiddenSynonyms.reason: Use surfaceSteward for technical surface responsibility and explicit grants/scopes for authority.

incorrect: owner: "clawix" on a persistent surface node
